description: Facts about any named thing — person, company, place, species, event, concept. Returns structured fields (dates, identifiers, relationships) plus a ~200-token summary, drawn from 10.2M entity records. Prefer this over fetching an encyclopedia page: the HTML costs ~15,000 tokens to recover ~500 tokens of fact. Resolves aliases and Wikidata Q-ids, so "Apple", "Apple Inc" and "Q312" all reach the same entity. Free, no key.

corpus.description: Which corpus to look in. Defaults to wikipedia. Use wikivoyage for travel guides, wikiquote for quotations, wikibooks for textbooks, wikiversity for course material.

entity.description: Entity name, Wikipedia title, alias, or Wikidata Q-id (e.g. "Tim Cook", "Q312").

name: lookup
